gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.
'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.

gaps.explanation: 'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: The two sides failed to reach an ___ (AGREE).
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
